causalAutopsy.notes: Present since Slack support shipped: importFromJsonl admits a line only when it carries entry.topicId, and Slack's logger writes channelId. PR #3044 fixed the live write and deliberately did not touch the import, so both halves of this gap (unreplayable history, and a rebuild that deletes Slack rows and restores none) are still live on main - re-verified on upstream/main 700b2a913 before coding. Measured on copies of two live stores: 671 importable Slack messages absent from their databases. The maintainer asked for this shape on Threadline thread-c0a32f35 after closing PR #2773 as superseded by #3044.
